name: shell-variants
comment: Showcases the 0.12 variants features on a self-contained scratch buffer: a 'variants' block of named co-varying bindings ('inserter' and 'expected' move together), the implicit {{variant}} binding, and a conditional map-form xfail (expected to fail ONLY under the 'loud' variant, with the reason kept next to the check). `elate matrix examples/shell-variants.json --emacs emacs` runs every variant; `elate run examples/shell-variants.json --variant loud` runs one. Plain `elate run` uses the params defaults (which mirror the 'plain' variant), so the file also works with no flags.

xfail.loud: demo: upcasing breaks the lowercase check -- a known break scoped to one variant
